description: XA30 parameter labels that differ from earlier releases beyond case, punctuation and the shared abbreviation table. XA30 and XA60 are both Numaris/X and agree on almost every label, so this file is close to a copy of the XA60 one; it is kept separate rather than aliased because the releases are free to diverge and a shared file would hide it when they do.

notes.Acceleration mode: XA30 prints a lowercase 'mode' where XA60 prints 'Mode'; both also print an abbreviated 'Accel. Mode'. Case and abbreviation are folded by the normalizer, so the entry is recorded in the spelling XA30 actually uses.
notes.B0 Shim: As in XA60, distinct from the separate Adjustment Strategy parameter.
notes.Load Images to MR View&GO: Same viewer rename as XA60; VE11C called it 'Load images to viewer'.

rejected.Normalize <- Prescan Normalize: Inherited from XA60: the Numaris/X releases merged two VE11C parameters into this one; see the VE11C vocabulary.
rejected.Reference Scans <- Reference scan mode: Inherited from XA60: Numaris/X split the VE11C parameter; see the VE11C vocabulary.
